description: ESP32-P4 + ESP32-C6 (SDIO) panel: 4.3in 480x800 MIPI-DSI ST7701S, GT911 touch, 32 MB PSRAM, 16 MB flash. Pins only from docs/CONCEPT.md section 4 (JP1) and section 8b (panel BSP).
_stages: Stage 2: display, touch, encoder, amp enable line. Stage 3: I2S-A duplex (DAC+ADC) + I2S-B slave (BT). The BT-module I2C expander (MCP23017) is not on the bench yet.

sdmmc_slots.label: microSD (TF). Pins CONFIRMED: they are the P4 slot-0 IOMUX defaults (soc/sdmmc_pins.h), and buccaneer-jak/JC4880P443C-... mounts this same panel with SD_MMC.begin() and no setPins(), i.e. on the defaults. 4-bit because that reference works in 4-bit and 1-bit leaves D3 unconfigured - on an SD card D3 also holds it in SD mode, and an undriven D3 is a card that never answers.

i2c_touch.label: GT911 capacitive touch (reports landscape 800x480 natively - no transform)

gpio_inputs.label: Encoder SW (JP1, strapping BOOTMODE, R34 10k up)

gpio_outputs.label: TPA3255 /RESET + PCM5102A XSMT (low = mute, ext. pull-down)

i2s_buses.label: I2S-A: PCM5102A DAC + PCM1808 ADC (JP1), P4 master 48 kHz

I2S-B in from the BT satellite (JP1). Satellite is master, all three P4 pins are inputs, no MCLK. Rate and width follow STREAM_FMT; these are only the values before the first one. CONCEPT 4. NOT BOUND yet

uart_buses.label: Control link to the BT satellite (J5, freed by removing R70/R75/R76). Far end GPIO16/17 on a WROOM. Wire format: docs/LINK_PROTOCOL.md. tx/rx here are an assignment, not a schematic fact - swap them if the pair is wired the other way
